column1: # Documentation sources indexed into the local docs MCP server.
# Extra args use the MCP tool's camelCase names: maxPages, maxDepth, excludePattern, includePattern, scope.
# Exclusions matter: changelogs/release-notes and translated doc trees are huge and will eat the
# page budget, pushing the pages you actually want out of the index. Always exclude them.
# Regex patterns must be wrapped in slashes. Backslashes need JSON escaping (\\/).
